title: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB — Entry Info (2027)
claims: The race date is 13-14 February 2027; start times are TMiler Saturday 04:00, T102 07:00, T50 07:00-07:20, T21 10:00 and T14 Sunday 07:30; the event hub is Village Green, Lakefront Drive, Rotorua.

TMiler qualification requires an official 50 km or longer trail race completed between 3 January 2025 and 3 January 2027, submitted by 3 January 2027; a backyard ultra of 8 yards or more is accepted, and the Blue Lake 24hr Miler Qualifier requires 10 laps (about 60 km) within 11 hours.
Athletes who do not meet the TMiler qualification by the cutoff date are moved into the T102.
The T102 has no pre-requisite of competing or finishing any trail running event, although ultra-trail experience assists with start group seeding.
Withdrawal refunds are 45% before 22 November 2026, 22% before 3 January 2027 and none after 3 January 2027.
The event is not suitable to be completed using wheelchairs or with prams across all distances because of course conditions.
Entry prices are TMiler NZ$1,090, T102 NZ$625, T50 NZ$445, T21 NZ$195 and T14 NZ$160, in New Zealand dollars including GST.
The TMiler deferral programme requires registration before 16 May 2026 and a request before 3 January 2027, with a NZ$55 deferral fee payable when entering the 2028 event.
